title: Event log scrolling
description: The event log opens at the newest entry and follows new events while the reader is at the bottom; a reader who scrolled up is left alone and gets a jump row; manual expansion survives a reconnect; the position survives hide/show. Synthetic mocked game (70 decisions over 2 rounds), 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 phone.

shots.heading: Desktop: pinned, a new event arrives
shots.caption: The log opens at the newest entry. After a new event the list is still at the bottom (gap 0 px; before the fix the gap grew 26 px per event, so the newest entries sat below the fold).

shots.heading: Phone drawer: pinned, a new event arrives
shots.caption: Same on the phone drawer: opened at the newest entry, still at the bottom after a new event (gap 0 px).

shots.heading: Desktop: a new round opens while pinned
shots.caption: A phase_transition into round 3 plus its first decision, then current_path moves to round 3: the new node auto-opens and the pinned list follows it (gap 0 px; before: 604 px, the new node was below the viewport).

shots.heading: Phone drawer: a new round opens while pinned
shots.caption: Same on the phone drawer (gap 0 px).

shots.heading: Desktop: scrolled to the top, a new event arrives
shots.caption: A reader who scrolled up is not moved (scrollTop stays 0). A 'N new events - Jump to latest' row appears above the list and counts what arrived; clicking it goes to the newest entry and the row disappears. Existing behaviour, plus the new row.

shots.heading: Phone drawer: scrolled to the top, a new event arrives
shots.caption: Same on the phone drawer.

shots.heading: Desktop: reconnect keeps the reader's place
shots.caption: A fresh initial_snapshot with the same history generation (reconnect) keeps the manually opened Round 1 and scrollTop 200 (before: Round 1 collapsed and the scroll position lost, 200 to 173). A new generation (undo/redo/restore) still resets the expansion; the scroll position is clamped into the shorter list and a pinned reader stays pinned.

shots.heading: Phone drawer: reconnect keeps the reader's place
shots.caption: Same on the phone drawer.

shots.heading: Desktop: hide, events arrive, show
shots.caption: The list unmounts while the log is hidden; its position is remembered. Reopened after two events arrived while hidden: scrollTop 150 restored (before: 0). A reader who was at the bottom reopens at the newest entry.

shots.heading: Phone drawer: close, events arrive, open
shots.caption: Same for the Events drawer: scrollTop 150 restored, and a pinned reader reopens at the newest entry.

notesHeading: Measurements (bottom gap = scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop, px)

notes.title: Pinned, new round and phase opens:
notes.text: before 604 px (new node below the viewport), after 0.

notes.title: Reconnect (same generation) with a manually opened Round 1:
notes.text: before Round 1 collapsed and scrollTop 200 became 173; after Round 1 stays open and scrollTop stays 200.

notes.title: Hide, then show at scrollTop 150:
notes.text: before 0; after 150. Pinned readers reopen at gap 0.

notes.title: Undo (new generation, shorter log):
notes.text: expansion resets, scrollTop is clamped into the shorter list (173 of max 447), a pinned reader stays at gap 0.

notes.title: Unchanged guards:
notes.text: scrolled to top or middle plus a new event keeps scrollTop; a manually expanded older node stays open with no jump; another player's event toast does not move or resize the log box.

notes.title: Not covered:
notes.text: the fixtures are synthetic; no real engine states and no screen reader pass. The log still has no aria-live (no new announcements were added).
